next.reason: 1985 (the rule comes from Amendment 1, X3.23a-1989): "A function-identifier which references an integer or numeric function may be used only in an arithmetic expression" (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4). 2023 lifts the limit: a function "may be used anywhere a sending data item of that class and category may be specified" (§2023:15.2, lead text with no catalog row), and of numeric and of integer functions it says "These are of the class and category numeric" (§2023:15.2 GR4, §2023:15.2 GR5). So 2023 accepts a numeric or integer function wherever a numeric sending operand is allowed (MOVE FUNCTION MAX (A B) TO C), which 1985 refuses. What survives of the refusal is "A function-identifier shall not be specified as a receiving operand" (§2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR1).
